item.title: Tesla sued over family killed in tragic Model X crash as ‘flood’ of lawsuits keep opening
item.description: A new lawsuit has been filed against Tesla following a tragic accident in Idaho that killed four family members, with the plaintiffs blaming the automaker’s Autosteer and driver-assist features for veering the Model X into an oncoming truck. This is just the latest in a wave of lawsuits hitting Tesla after the automaker lost its first major Autopilot trial last year. Warning: this is a heartbreaking story. more…
